name: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
summary: Post-matric scholarship for SC/ST students of Bihar from Class XI onwards, covering course fees and maintenance through the state PMS portal.

benefit.details: DBT into an Aadhaar-seeded account after institute + district verification.

deadline.label: Bihar PMS 2026–27 CLOSED on 30 Sep 2026 (window was 15 Jul – 30 Sep)

special_conditions: Caste certificate issued by a competent Bihar authority required
Only one state scholarship may be availed at a time
An NSP One Time Registration (OTR) number is now required before the state portal will accept the application — generate it on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar first, it is not instant
Income certificate must be dated on or after 1 April 2026
Aadhaar seeding of the bank account is mandatory — the application cannot be finalised without it
At most three defect corrections, each re-finalised within 15 days

steps: Fill academic details and upload caste + income certificates

notes: PORTAL CHANGE: SC/ST post-matric applications now run on scstpmsonline.bihar.gov.in, separately from the BC/EBC portal. The 2026–27 window was 15 July to 30 September 2026, extended from an original 15 September close. New for this cycle: an NSP OTR number is required to register, the income certificate must be dated on or after 1 April 2026, academic documents must fall between 1 April 2026 and 31 March 2027, Aadhaar-bank seeding is mandatory before the form can be finalised, and a student gets at most three defect corrections, each within 15 days.

name: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship for BC & EBC Students
summary: Post-matric scholarship for Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class (OBC) students of Bihar studying Class XI and above.

benefit.details: Course-wise maintenance allowance; hosteller rates higher.

deadline.label: Bihar PMS 2026–27 CLOSED on 30 Sep 2026 (window was 15 Jul – 30 Sep)

special_conditions: BC (OBC-B type) or EBC certificate of Bihar required
Income cap has been revised upward in recent orders (₹3 lakh) — re-verify current order
An NSP One Time Registration (OTR) number is now required before the state portal will accept the application — generate it on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar first, it is not instant
Income certificate must be dated on or after 1 April 2026
Aadhaar seeding of the bank account is mandatory

notes: PORTAL CHANGE: BC/EBC post-matric applications run on pmsonline.bihar.gov.in. The legacy pmsonline.bih.nic.in address is still referenced by older guides. Window was 15 July to 30 September 2026. Same new prerequisites as the SC/ST portal: NSP OTR, income certificate dated on/after 1 April 2026, and mandatory Aadhaar-bank seeding.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana — Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan
summary: ₹25,000 incentive to unmarried girl students of Bihar on passing graduation — a continuation bonus keeping girls in higher education.

benefit.details: Credited to the girl's Aadhaar-seeded bank account after verification of graduation documents.

special_conditions: Girl must have *passed* graduation from a Bihar-recognised university
Unmarried at the time of application
Apply within the notified window after results

documents: Class X domicile/age proof of Bihar

steps: Open the E-Kalyan portal after graduation results
Register with Aadhaar and verify bank account via PFMS
Fill personal + graduation details, upload documents

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCC)
provider: Department of Education, Government of Bihar
summary: Education loan up to ₹4 lakh at simple interest for Bihar students pursuing higher education — the state stands guarantee instead of collateral.

benefit.amount_display: Loan up to ₹4,00,000 @ 4% simple interest (1% for girls/disabled/transgender applicants)
benefit.details: Sanctioned through banks under DRCC facilitation; covers tuition, books, boarding and laptop expenses.

deadline.label: Rolling — apply through DRCC any time

special_conditions: Class XII pass from a recognised board
Admission in a recognised/NAAC-accredited institution on the approved course list
Co-applicant (parent/guardian) required on the loan

steps: Fill course, institution and co-applicant details
Book and attend a DRCC appointment with originals
Bank processes and issues the student credit card/sanction

notes: Modelled as a grant-type record (it is a government-guaranteed *loan*, not a scholarship) — the display string clarifies terms.

name: Mukhyamantri Balak/Balika Protsahan Yojana (Class XII Incentive)
summary: ₹10,000 incentive for unmarried students of Bihar who pass the BSEB Intermediate (Class XII) exam with first or second division.

benefit.details: DBT after document verification on the Medhasoft/E-Kalyan portal.

special_conditions: BSEB Intermediate pass with 1st or 2nd division (45%+ modelled)
Applicant must be unmarried
Separate rates may apply for boys vs girls in some years

steps: Register on Medhasoft after Inter results
Track through college/district verification to DBT

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Yojana (EBC / BC Incentive)
summary: ₹10,000 incentive for students of Extremely Backward Class and Backward Class communities who clear Class XII with first division.

benefit.details: Direct transfer after portal verification of caste and marksheet.

special_conditions: BC/EBC certificate of Bihar required
First division (60%+) in Class XII
Income criterion, when notified, applies — historical orders have not always capped income

steps: Upload caste certificate and Inter marksheet

notes: Income-bar presence varies by notification cycle — re-verify when the current order publishes.
